lines.en: I drag one leg as I walk
My steps fall uneven
I walk hunched, as if exhausted
My flesh hangs from the bone

lines.zh: 我一步一步朝有活气的地方走
lines.en: I head toward whatever's alive
I crunch over Nether rubble
I stop, then drag on

lines.zh: 我举起一条手臂，又落下
lines.en: I lift an arm and let it fall
I go around the flames

lines.zh: 我的嘴里发出干涩的声音
lines.en: A dry sound comes from my mouth

lines.zh: 我的肩甲，是从尸体上拿的。
lines.en: My pauldron came off a corpse.
I keep walking without asking where
I stand and sway
My jaw hangs loose
I stare at a spot in the distance
My fingers never stop moving
I smell flesh
I remember nothing
I lean on the rock, wheezing
Flame passes by and I don't flinch
I tug at the rags on me
I wait for my next breath
You're standing, and alive
I tilt my head at you
I remember being like that
I raise a hand and let it drop
Better step away from me
There are no words in my throat
I drag one step nearer
I smell your blood

lines.zh: 你的样子让我想起什么
lines.en: Your shape reminds me of something
I shouldn't be here
I sway and don't fall
My arm drops
I step back, then forward
I don't cry out; I only wheeze
The rags on me tear again
I look at the wound; there's no blood
A bone shifts out of place
I stop and wait for the next blow
I clutch at my chest
I drag myself around
It's alive, and still warm
That smell pulls me forward
I hold out both hands
A little nearer to me
I stand with my mouth open, waiting
Your hand is warm
I'd love one bite of that
I'm not hungry, but I want it
I knew this smell once
Don't walk so fast
You hit me and I stagger
My hand closes on your arm
I'm pushed back two steps and come again

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，我身上很凉
lines.en: We're pressed together; I'm cold

lines.zh: 你从我的手臂下钻出去
lines.en: You duck under my arm
My bones knock your shoulder
The blow knocks me apart at the joints
You step on my foot and I don't care
I hold on and won't let go
I go down and get back up

lines.zh: 还有别的东西在林子里走
lines.en: Something else walks in the wastes

lines.zh: 下界的火里，我们互相看一眼。
lines.en: In the Nether fire, we share one glance.
Its face is ruined too
We drag along side by side
It's slower than I am
We stop together
It grips my arm

lines.zh: 怨灵的脸，早就被拉长了。
lines.en: A revenant's face stretched long ago.
We head for the same place
There will be more of us here
I bend and take it up
It sways in my hand
I bite it and a tooth comes loose
I press it against my chest
It drops and I can't pick it up
I walk along holding it up
This thing tastes of metal
I don't know what it's for
I'll hold it; someone might want it
I put it down and forget

lines.zh: 那口气又顶上来了，我伸手。
lines.en: That breath rises in me again, and I reach out.
I reach both hands toward you
That breath rises in my throat
I walk a little faster
I feel no pain, and no fear

lines.zh: 这具身体还记得怎么抓
lines.en: This body still remembers how to grab
You're ahead of me; I smell you
I drag a foot closer
My arms have come up
Run; I'll still be walking
I'm what was left behind
Catching you is enough
I hear your chest beating

lines.zh: 我不着急，我从来不用急
lines.en: No hurry; I never needed any
I follow you, dragging my leg

lines.zh: 你跑到那边，我就走过去
lines.en: You run over there; I'll walk there
I stop every step, but I don't stop
My arms reach far
You haven't noticed me closing in
I round the lava pool

lines.zh: 我从后面来，从不在前面
lines.en: I come from behind, never the front
My breathing is harsh
Punch me and I'll still walk
Even down, I keep crawling
The Nether's Unwilling don't walk fast.
I stay five steps behind

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我看得清
lines.en: You raise the torch; I see clearly
I'm not afraid of burning
As long as this body still moves
I'll reach you
I seize your shoulder
That's not a blow, only a grab

lines.zh: 我的指甲插进你的袖子
lines.en: My nails go into your sleeve

lines.zh: 我扑上去，把重量压给你
lines.en: I lunge and drop my weight on you
I drag you a step forward
My forehead hits your face

lines.zh: 这一下打空了，我差点摔倒
lines.en: I miss and nearly fall
I catch your legs from the ground

lines.zh: 我的牙齿咬在你的护甲上
lines.en: My teeth close on your armor
You shove me off; I come back
My hand finds your throat

lines.zh: 这一下很慢，可你没有躲开
lines.en: It's slow, yet you don't dodge
Cut me and I'm still grabbing

lines.zh: 我的手指扣进你的皮甲
lines.en: My fingers dig into your leathers
You hear my bones
I haven't given half a step

lines.zh: 火堆那边站起来一个影子
lines.en: A shape rises by the fire
I crawl out of a rock fissure
Bits of me still fall away
This place was always meant to have me

lines.zh: 我从火堆的余烬里坐起来。
lines.en: I sit up out of the embers of the fire.
My shadow is bent like a person's
The hot wind of the Nether wakes me
I raise my head and see you

lines.zh: 我不记得自己怎么来的
lines.en: I don't remember how I got here
Old iron still hangs on me
I drag through two steps
The air tastes of sulfur

lines.zh: 我烧着往前走，火粘在皮上
lines.en: I walk on burning, flame stuck to my skin

lines.zh: 我从岩台上摔下去，骨头发响
lines.en: I fall from the ledge and my bones crack
Lava clogs my throat

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀得七零八落
lines.en: The blast scatters me

lines.zh: 箭钉在我胸口，我照旧走
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my chest and I walk on

lines.zh: 那股力量让我这具身体发麻
lines.en: That force numbs what's left of this body
I stopped feeling hunger long ago

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我在地上抽动
lines.en: Lightning falls and I twitch on the ground
Nothing below catches me
